material_update_promotion_decisions.reason: Both articles cover the identical hoarding case: 36 Border Collies removed from Palm City on Aug. 10, now at Humane Society of the Treasure Coast with adoptions opening Sept. 1. The incoming article adds breed education, volunteer observations about recovery, and adoption criteria details (fenced yards, no apartments), but these are explanatory background and routine progress updates, not material developments like charges, court rulings, or victim identification. The breed education angle is useful context but does not constitute an independently newsworthy follow-up that would merit its own headline for readers already aware of the rescue. This content should update the existing canonical.
